crossRefs.note: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.
Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

translations.web: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
translations.bsb: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
translations.kjv: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
translations.asv: How much more them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Who are crushed before the moth!
